title: Extension under a fixed restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ map sign vectors on $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to a type $\alpha$, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and fix a sign assignment $z$ on the complement of $J$. The extension of $f$ associated with $J$ and $z$ maps each sign vector $x$ to the value of $f$ at the sign vector that agrees with $x$ on $J$ and with $z$ outside $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $z$ assigns signs on the complement of $J$
